Amazing! That's what a doctor should be like. They work with heart. They explained every step, what to do and what not to do, what's possible and what's not. Their touch was so gentle; I didn't feel any pain at all.
#Good things deserve to be said, right?
#Thank you
#This is the kind of doctor I want.

No advice at all. Terrible experience. Very disappointed.
